notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped ordinary attribute update surface across alternate time-advance services. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies delivery and grant boundaries for Flush Queue Request, Time Advance Request Available, and Next Message Request Available without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped UpdateAttributeValues with FlushQueueRequest, TimeAdvanceRequestAvailable, and NextMessageRequestAvailable and FederateAmbassador reflection/grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped attribute update and alternate time-advance declarations
